judgment_calls.topic: Anaphylaxis bullet in the red box
judgment_calls.decision: Encoded as an Urgent criterion (it is inside 'Give urgent attention ... any of') and as a possible anaphylaxis rule to prompt page 28.
White patches AND (difficulty OR pain on swallowing), because the box hangs under the white-patches column.
Require red cracked corners of mouth plus the extra sign, following the column.
Any one of them with dry mouth gives possible diabetes.
judgment_calls.alternatives: All three required; or no dry mouth requirement.
